Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Trap will provide a free press to continue if any cards have been played
within the last three rounds. This includes Trap itself. So a Trapped
combat will last four rounds, assuming no cards are played after
the first round.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
